nodes.name: Sklearn HDBSCAN DBSCAN Clustering Helpers
nodes.description: Deterministic HDBSCAN helpers for postprocessing DBSCAN-style labels after the deferred labelling-at-cut callback.

nodes.name: hdbscan_dbscan_infinite_mask
nodes.description: Infer HDBSCAN's infinite-row mask from fitted labels.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function executes in constant time and space as it only performs simple validation checks, variable assignments, or returns inputs.

nodes.name: hdbscan_dbscan_missing_mask
nodes.description: Infer HDBSCAN's missing-row mask from fitted labels.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function executes in constant time and space as it only performs simple validation checks, variable assignments, or returns inputs.

nodes.name: hdbscan_dbscan_labels
nodes.description: Apply HDBSCAN's infinite and missing outlier overrides to labels already computed at a tree cut.
nodes.type_signature: (labels_at_cut: NDArray[np.int_], infinite_mask: NDArray[np.bool_], missing_mask: NDArray[np.bool_]) -> NDArray[np.int_]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computing cluster labels from DBSCAN sample-to-sample connectivity graph takes quadratic time in samples and linear space for label arrays.
